question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct option is "come".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The phrase **"come a long way"** means** to have made significant progress or improvement from a past situation, often implying that the progress has been difficult or challenging.**
 
• Here is an example sentence:
 
 
• "Since the early days of the women's rights movement, we have** come a long way** in terms of achieving greater gender equality."
 
 
 
• So, **'**come' is the most appropriate word for the given blank. 
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer. 

Correct Paragraph:__ *Allegiance to one’s favourite team is something that sports fans (1) __develop__* *over a period of time. They are so attached to their favourite teams that they could display (2) __varied__ emotions, not just during the course of the match, but much after the actual event is over. This phenomenon, (3) __though__* *common across the globe, is more seen in countries like Brazil, India, the US and even the UK, where the favourite sport may not be the same in each of these nations. In spite of this craze and hysteria, sport has **(4) __come__ **a long way. It is accepted as one of the world’s most (5) ______ pastimes ever.*
